name: DCA Cocina Cucamonga Pollo Asado Soft Corn Tacos (Rice & Hold Lime)
brandOrRestaurant: Cocina Cucamonga Mexican Grill (Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Citrus-free achiote-marinated grilled chicken served in soft warm corn tortillas with cilantro and Spanish rice. Lean protein and gentle carbs without frying fat.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pollo Asado Tacos on soft corn tortillas; request no raw diced onions and discard the lime wedge.
watchOuts: Hold raw diced white onions and discard the lime wedge
